text.p: A suit seeking class action status was filed in the United States District Court for the Northern District of California on behalf of purchasers of Read-Rite Corp common stock between July 19, 1995 and June 19, 1996, plaintiffs' lawyers said Thursday.

The complaint, filed January 21, alleges Read-Rite and three of its officers and directors issued misleading statements and omitted material facts regarding the company's products, operations, and financial performance, including alleged misrepresentations about demand for the company's products, said a statement issued by the law firms of Berger & Montague, PC and Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach LLP.

By issuing these allegedly false statements, defendants artificially inflated the market price of Read-Rite stock, enabling the individual defendants to sell hundreds of thousands of shares of their Read-Rite stock at artificially inflated prices, reaping proceeds of more than $12 million, the statement said.
Separately, Read-Rite said there is no basis for the lawsuit and the company intends to fight the lawsuit.
Plaintiffs are seeking damages, the statement said.
